newsitem.title: USA: Stratosphere gets balance of loan.
newsitem.headline: Stratosphere gets balance of loan.

text.p: Stratosphere Corp said Tuesday it has received the balance of a $50 million loan from Grand Casinos Inc fulfilling the previously announced construction completion guaranty.
Grand Casinos currently owns 42 percent of Stratosphere and agreed to provide the completion guaranty as part of Stratosphere's $203 million first mortgage note offering in March of 1995.
Stratosphere said in a statement that the Grand Casino loan has an interest rate of 14.25 percent and is unsecured and subordinate to the first mortgage notes.
The funding of the balance of the loan does not alter the previously announced suspension of construction on Phase II of the Stratosphere project.
